stem:
Which of the following is the correct experimental set-up for verification of laws of reflection of sound?

(The options are four set-ups A, B, C, D. Each has a reflecting board at the top, two inclined tubes meeting at the board, and a vertical screen/barrier placed below along the normal to block sound travelling directly between the tubes. In set-up A the two tubes touch the board at one point on its surface (the point of incidence) with the screen below; the other set-ups have the tubes meeting away from the board surface or are otherwise incorrect.)
